name: Gac rice cake
summary: VOV lists bánh dày gấc at the 2019 Pac Ngoi weekend market, beside bánh gai and five-colour sticky rice. The provincial portal pairs the name with the mugwort cake and does not describe a gấc filling.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV, 25 September 2019. The Thái Nguyên portal captions the name on 1 April 2026.
howToEat: Eat it at the market or the house. A filling beyond the name gấc is Check on arrival. A sauce was not printed.
Whether the 2019 market still opens is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Pac Ngoi. The 2019 weekend market listed it. Bo Lu holds the Long Tong bánh dày contest, and VietnamPlus does not say the contest cake is the gấc one.
seoTitle: Gac rice cake at Ba Be
seoDescription: Bánh dày gấc, listed by VOV at the 2019 Pac Ngoi market. A filling beyond the name is Check on arrival.
